svg.text: Shifting = moving a piece one step
Because index = 8·rank + file, each direction is just "add or subtract a fixed number"
d4 is square 27. Every number on the board is its square index.
Moving UP the board makes the index bigger → shift LEFT (<<)
Moving DOWN makes the index smaller → shift RIGHT (>>)
Up one rank = ±8, over one file = ±1, diagonals = 8±1
Shifting the whole uint64_t moves EVERY piece on it at once.
